concept: EC2 purchasing: Compute Savings Plan for flexible baseline load
tests: Choosing a discount model for a constant baseline load with the ability to change instance families and regions.
expected: Compute Savings Plan — a $/hour commitment; the discount applies to any family, size and region, plus Fargate/Lambda. Triggers: "baseline always-on", "flexibility to change instance families and regions".
why_not: Standard RIs are tied to an instance type; Spot gets interrupted; On-Demand has no discount.
